title: Read v. J. Lyons & Co. Ltd.

content.caseIdentity: Read v. J. Lyons & Co. Ltd., [1947] AC 156 (House of Lords)
content.holding: Held that where an explosion occurred inside an ordnance factory injuring an inspector, strict liability under Rylands did not apply because there was no escape of the dangerous thing beyond the boundary of the premises.
content.relevance: Authoritative precedent defining the strict requirement of "escape" in common law strict liability.
